result_text:
I changed the "Undefined Team" remainder so it only collects active unmatched contributors. The module compiles and its tests ran offline with no failures reported. I didn't capture the Maven exit code, so that result rests on the absence of error output.

The change is in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, in `getAllTeams`. The remainder condition now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`. Configured teams are untouched, and blank latest-commit dates still count as active because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for blank input.

No existing test covers this method, so I didn't add one. Nothing was committed.
